faqList.title: Does the Casino Bank of Scotland promo code exist?
faqList.text: Yes, the platform periodically releases promo codes tied to specific campaigns and seasonal offers. Active codes can be found in the promotions section of the platform or via partnered affiliate sites. Entering a valid code during deposit unlocks the associated reward on top of any existing bonus.

faqList.title: Is it possible to play for free before registering?
faqList.text: Most slots and instant games are available in demo mode without an account. This lets you test mechanics, volatility and features before committing real money. Live dealer games do not have a demo option and require a registered account.

faqList.title: Is there a Casino Bank of Scotland app for both iOS and Android?
faqList.text: Yes, the app is available for both platforms and covers the full game catalogue. It supports all account functions including deposits, withdrawals and bonus activation. Performance and loading speed are consistent with the desktop version.
